headline: Solstad Maritime Delivers Record Q3 EBITDA and Raises Annual Guidance
summary: Offshore vessel operator Solstad Maritime reported record EBITDA results in the third quarter of 2026 and upgraded its financial guidance for the full year.
why: Solstad Maritime provides offshore vessels and maritime services to oil and gas firms, serving as an indicator of global offshore energy infrastructure demand.
